newsitem.title: USA: Equity Inns in pact to lease 45 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Equity Inns in pact to lease 45 hotels.

text.p: Equity Inns Inc said Thursday an Interstate Hotels Co affiliate will become the lessee of all of the REIT's 45 owned hotels.
The agreement in principle calls for the current lessee of Equity Inns' hotels, Trust Leasing Inc, to assign the leases to Interstate Hotels, Equity said.

Equity Inns Chairman Phillip McNeill Sr is the sole shareholder of Trust Leasing Inc and he will get about two million shares of Interstate common in exchange for assigning the leases to Interstate, as well as assigning to Interstate 12 hotel management contracts not affiliated with the REIT, Equity said.
McNeill has agreed to buy 500,000 shares of Equity Inns common over the next two years if the deal is completed.
The transactions are subject to approval of Equity's board, regulatory approval, consent of franchisors and completion of definitive documentation.
